applicability: The central statement comparison for a selected invariant.
conditions: The primary owner revision_selection matches the requested subject kind and identity.
The before and after statement operands come from that same selected-subject read.
exclusions: Ambiguous or unresolved heads do not establish a before/after pair.
A retained roster revision is context and does not select the primary statement comparison.
This obligation does not promise a manual per-side pairing control.
statement: The selected invariant statement uses the primary owner's exact before and after operands and revision selection; ambiguous or unresolved selections create no inferred pair.
